subject: cardboardRobot
pitch:
Category: Humanoid character.
Subject: kid in a cardboard-box robot costume.
Style: cardboard craft.

spec.name: Cardboard Box Robot Kid
spec.description: A child in a homemade cardboard-box robot costume: boxy torso and head box, foil-covered limbs, bottle-cap buttons, duct-tape seams and marker-drawn details.
spec.layout: A 1.3 m tall kid stands facing +Z in a neutral T-pose-ish rest: arms out at the sides, legs slightly apart. Kid proportions are big-headed. Legs: dark sneakers on the floor, jeans, and silver foil-wrapped dryer-duct shins. Torso: a large cardboard box (0.52 wide, 0.5 tall, 0.36 deep) from y 0.5 to 1.0 with arm holes at the sides, a control panel on the front with bottle-cap buttons, dials, a marker-drawn screen, and duct-tape seams. Head: a smaller cardboard box (0.34 cube) from y 0.98 to 1.32 worn over the kid's head, with a cut face window at the front showing the kid's face (skin, eyes, smile, hair fringe), two bottle-cap ears, a toilet-roll antenna with a spring, and a flap lid at the top. Arms stick out of the torso side holes: skin upper arms, silver foil tube sleeves, and glove hands with spread fingers. Everything is flat cardboard brown with visible corrugated edge strips, tape in grey and red, marker lines in black, and foil in silver. Hand-made, slightly irregular, craft look.

parts.builds: Both legs: jeans thighs (tapered boxes/sweeps) from hips to knees, silver foil-wrapped duct shins with crinkle facets and darker foil bands, red tape knee rings, chunky white sneakers with soles, toe caps, laces as small marker-coloured strips and a Velcro strap. Chains hipL/kneeL/ankleL and mirrored R, legs slightly apart. Feet rest on the floor.
parts.attaches: Top at hips mount; under the torso box bottom (y 0.5).

parts.builds: The cardboard torso box: main shell box with lighter top flaps folded and a darker inside rim, corrugation edge strips on the corners, grey and red duct-tape seams across the front and sides, arm holes cut on each side with dark inner rims, shoulder straps of tape, a front control panel (foil rectangle) with three bottle-cap buttons (red, blue, yellow), two dials with marker tick marks, a green marker-drawn screen with black scribble waveform, a hand-lettered marker emblem/bolts, and a small kid shirt-coloured collar visible at the neck opening on top. Slightly uneven handmade offsets.
parts.attaches: Sits on legs at torsoBottom; holds neck at torsoTop; arms exit at shoulderL/R holes; headBox rests on torsoTop.

parts.builds: The cardboard head box: cube shell around the kid's head with a cut face window on +Z showing the kid's face: skin face block, two big eyes (white, dark pupil, highlight), brows, nose, smile in mouth colour, rosy cheeks, and hair fringe and side tufts under the window top. Bottle-cap ears on both sides (disc stacks in red and blue), a toilet-roll tube antenna on top with a thin coiled spring and a yellow bottle-cap ball, red tape on edges, corrugation strips, folded top flaps with one flap slightly open, marker rivets and a drawn mouth grille below the window. Neck: small skin cylinder inside the torso opening.
parts.attaches: Rests on torsoTop/neck mount; face window at faceWindow mount; riding head joint.

parts.builds: The model's left (+X) arm extended sideways in T-pose: skin upper arm coming out of the torso hole, silver foil tube sleeve over the forearm with crinkle bands and a red tape cuff, yellow glove hand with palm box, four spread fingers with 2 segments each and a thumb, plus a tiny cardboard claw-style cuff flap. Chain shoulderL/elbowL/wristL with digit joints optional.
parts.attaches: Starts inside the torso arm hole at shoulderL mount.

parts.builds: The model's right (-X) arm mirroring the left: skin upper arm out of the torso hole, foil tube forearm sleeve with crinkle facets and red tape cuff, yellow glove with palm, four spread fingers and a thumb, matching in size and construction to the left arm.
parts.attaches: Starts inside the torso arm hole at shoulderR mount.
